examples.en: The cave is underground and very dark.
examples.zh: 这个洞穴在地下，而且很暗。

examples.en: We walked through the underground passage to the other side.
examples.zh: 我们走过地下通道到了另一边。

examples.en: The underground cable brings electricity to our city.
examples.zh: 地下电缆为我们的城市供电。

examples.en: He drove at a speed of 90 mph.
examples.zh: 他以每小时90英里的速度开车。

examples.en: The car's top speed is 155 mph.
examples.zh: 这辆车的最高速度是每小时155英里。

examples.en: Please slow down your speed near the crossing.
examples.zh: 请在十字路口附近降低速度。

examples.en: We took a high-speed train to Beijing, it was very fast.
examples.zh: 我们乘坐高速列车去北京，它非常快。

examples.en: The high-speed train arrives at the station in ten minutes.
examples.zh: 高速列车将在十分钟后到达车站。

examples.en: My father often goes to Shanghai by high-speed train for work.
examples.zh: 我父亲经常坐高速列车去上海工作。

examples.en: She used to live in a big city.
examples.zh: 她曾经住在一个大城市里。

examples.en: She used to love dancing, but now she doesn't.
examples.zh: 她曾经喜欢跳舞，但现在不了。

examples.en: You don't visit me like you used to.
examples.zh: 你不像以前那样来看我了。

examples.en: The bar was crowded by ten o'clock.
examples.zh: 十点钟时酒吧里很拥挤。

examples.en: Shops get more crowded as Christmas comes.
examples.zh: 随着圣诞节临近，商店变得更加拥挤。

examples.en: Chen nodded to her across the crowded room.
examples.zh: 陈在拥挤的房间里向她点头致意。

examples.en: Our local shop's hours are very convenient.
examples.zh: 我们本地商店的营业时间非常方便。

examples.en: A bike is a convenient way to get around.
examples.zh: 自行车是一种方便的出行方式。

examples.en: It's convenient that you live near the office.
examples.zh: 你住在办公室附近很方便。

examples.en: Sprint suits were a new innovation for the Olympics.
examples.zh: 短跑服是奥运会的一项新创新。

examples.en: New innovations help us drill with less harm to nature.
examples.zh: 新的创新帮助我们减少对自然的伤害。

examples.en: These are the latest innovations in computer technology.
examples.zh: 这些是计算机技术的最新创新。

examples.en: We took a southern route to the beach.
examples.zh: 我们走了一条南边的路线去海滩。

examples.en: The Southern Hemisphere has more ocean than land.
examples.zh: 南半球海洋比陆地多。

examples.en: The ship turned south and sailed to southern Ireland.
examples.zh: 船转向南，驶向南爱尔兰。

examples.en: This high-tech weapon system is not expensive.
examples.zh: 这个高科技武器系统不贵。

examples.en: They used high-tech ways to build this building.
examples.zh: 他们用高科技方法建造了这栋楼。

examples.en: The hospital has the newest high-tech equipment.
examples.zh: 这家医院有最新的高科技设备。

examples.en: The laser beam is very bright and strong.
examples.zh: 激光束非常明亮且强烈。

examples.en: Doctors use laser surgery to fix eyes.
examples.zh: 医生用激光手术来修复眼睛。

examples.en: A small cut lets the laser tube go into the body.
examples.zh: 一个小切口让激光管进入身体。

examples.en: He is one of the pioneers of modern science.
examples.zh: 他是现代科学的先驱之一。

examples.en: She is a pioneer heart doctor.
examples.zh: 她是一位先驱心脏医生。

examples.en: The pioneers moved west and cut down trees.
examples.zh: 先驱者们向西迁移并砍伐树木。

examples.en: Can we reform the unfair voting system?
examples.zh: 我们能改革不公平的投票制度吗？

examples.en: He drank too much, but he reformed after his doctor's warning.
examples.zh: 他曾经喝酒太多，但医生警告后他改好了。

examples.en: The boss gave him the power to reform the club.
examples.zh: 老板给了他改革俱乐部的权力。

examples.en: The problem is very serious now.
examples.zh: 现在这个问题非常严重。

examples.en: We are very sorry for what happened.
examples.zh: 我们对发生的事情非常抱歉。

examples.en: Think about it very carefully before you decide.
examples.zh: 在你做决定之前，请非常仔细地想一想。

examples.en: Friendship is at the heart of a happy school life.
examples.zh: 友谊是快乐学校生活的核心。

examples.en: Good communication is at the heart of every strong family.
examples.zh: 良好的沟通是每个稳固家庭的核心。

examples.en: The teacher put honesty at the heart of the class rules.
examples.zh: 老师把诚实放在班规的核心位置。

examples.en: Computer technology helps us learn and play.
examples.zh: 计算机技术帮助我们学习和玩耍。

examples.en: Modern technology is really cool, isn't it?
examples.zh: 现代技术真的很酷，不是吗？

examples.en: The country needs a plan for science and technology.
examples.zh: 这个国家需要一项关于科学和技术的计划。

examples.en: Our tech support team is always online for your device.
examples.zh: 我们的技术支持团队随时在线为你的设备服务。

examples.en: Tech specs tell us about a computer's CPU and memory.
examples.zh: 技术规格告诉我们电脑的处理器和内存情况。

examples.en: He worried the tech check was too short, and the smoke machine failed.
examples.zh: 他担心技术检查太短了，而且烟雾机出了问题。

examples.en: This town needs more trade and industry.
examples.zh: 这个城镇需要更多的贸易和工业。

examples.en: Industry and commerce help the city grow.
examples.zh: 工业和商业帮助城市发展。

examples.en: The city wants to bring in new industry.
examples.zh: 这个城市想引进新工业。

examples.en: Dad scared us with stories of a giant that ate kids.
examples.zh: 爸爸用吃小孩的巨人的故事吓唬我们。

examples.en: In the play, we saw the giant's big hand.
examples.zh: 在戏剧里，我们看到了巨人的大手。

examples.en: People tell tales of an island of giants, as tall as houses.
examples.zh: 人们传说有个岛上住着巨人，像房子一样高。

examples.en: We chose the right person to lead the trip.
examples.zh: 我们选对了人来带领这次旅行。

examples.en: I asked Gemma to lead the talk.
examples.zh: 我让Gemma来主持这次讨论。

examples.en: Who will lead the accident study?
examples.zh: 谁来领导这次事故调查？

examples.en: I'm so cold that I can't move my fingers.
examples.zh: 我太冷了，手指都动不了。

examples.en: Can you move this table to the back room?
examples.zh: 你能把这张桌子搬到后面的房间吗？

examples.en: We can move the meeting from 2 p.m. to 3 p.m.
examples.zh: 我们可以把会议从下午两点改到三点。

examples.en: She made a lot of wealth in her business career.
examples.zh: 她在商业生涯中积累了大量财富。

examples.en: Great wealth and terrible poverty live in the same city.
examples.zh: 巨大的财富和可怕的贫困共存于同一座城市。

examples.en: Their policies are all for creating wealth.
examples.zh: 他们的政策都是为了创造财富。

examples.en: The library has a wealth of books for us to read.
examples.zh: 图书馆有大量的书籍供我们阅读。

examples.en: She got a wealth of knowledge from her science teacher.
examples.zh: 她从科学老师那里获得了丰富的知识。

examples.en: Our school provides a wealth of activities after class.
examples.zh: 我们学校课后提供丰富多彩的活动。

examples.en: The food tasted excellent.
examples.zh: 这食物尝起来很棒。

examples.en: Her car is in excellent shape.
examples.zh: 她的车状态极好。

examples.en: Lower interest rates are excellent news for borrowers.
examples.zh: 低利率对借款人是极好的消息。

examples.en: Smaller classes can help raise educational standards.
examples.zh: 小班上课有助于提高教育水平。

examples.en: She has studied in many educational schools.
examples.zh: 她在许多教育类学校学习过。

examples.en: Dad never went to a rock show, so it will be an educational experience.
examples.zh: 爸爸从没去过摇滚演唱会，所以这对他来说会是次有教育意义的经历。

examples.en: Carlos got the first prize award in the writing contest.
examples.zh: 卡洛斯在写作比赛中获得了一等奖。

examples.en: The court awarded him a big damage payment.
examples.zh: 法院判给他一大笔赔偿金。

examples.en: The school awarded her a travel grant of $500.
examples.zh: 学校授予她500美元的旅行补助金。

examples.en: Public opinion has turned against him.
examples.zh: 公众舆论已经转而反对他。

examples.en: Is it in the public interest to share this?
examples.zh: 分享这个符合公众利益吗？

examples.en: We must raise public awareness of the disease.
examples.zh: 我们必须提高公众对这种疾病的认识。

examples.en: The British Embassy helps British citizens living abroad.
examples.zh: 英国大使馆帮助住在国外的英国公民。

examples.en: He asked to become an American citizen.
examples.zh: 他申请成为美国公民。

examples.en: This will affect all citizens of this country.
examples.zh: 这会影响这个国家的所有公民。

examples.en: We like to walk on the greenway after school.
examples.zh: 我们喜欢放学后在林荫道上散步。

examples.en: The greenway is a good place for morning runs.
examples.zh: 林荫道是晨跑的好地方。

examples.en: There are many trees and flowers along the greenway.
examples.zh: 林荫道两旁有许多树和花。

examples.en: My mom bought an electric car last month.
examples.zh: 我妈妈上个月买了一辆电动车。

examples.en: The electric bill for July was one hundred dollars.
examples.zh: 七月份的电费是一百美元。

examples.en: We changed from gas to electric heating this year.
examples.zh: 我们今年从燃气取暖换成了电取暖。

examples.en: She works as a town planner in our city.
examples.zh: 她在我们城市做城市规划师。

examples.en: The local planner made a map for the new park.
examples.zh: 这位当地规划师为新公园画了一张地图。

examples.en: He is a planner and helps design schools.
examples.zh: 他是一位规划者，帮助设计学校。

examples.en: Emma left for New York a year ago, and we haven't seen her since.
examples.zh: 艾玛一年前去了纽约，从那以后我们就没见过她。

examples.en: He joined the company in 1995, and has worked there since.
examples.zh: 他1995年加入这家公司，从那以后一直在那里工作。

examples.en: I have forgotten all my Latin since I left school.
examples.zh: 自从离开学校，我就把拉丁语全忘光了。

examples.en: Good food helps children's healthy growth and development.
examples.zh: 好的食物有助于孩子们的健康成长和发展。

examples.en: The film showed the development of pop music over time.
examples.zh: 这部电影展示了流行音乐随时间的发展。

examples.en: The area has too little development and many poor people.
examples.zh: 这个地区发展不足，有很多穷人。

examples.en: She used pioneering ways to help sick kids.
examples.zh: 她用开拓性的方法帮助生病的孩子们。

examples.en: He is a pioneering doctor in our city.
examples.zh: 他是我们城市的一位开拓性医生。

examples.en: They did pioneering work on water safety.
examples.zh: 他们在水安全方面做了开拓性的工作。

examples.en: Too many rules may kill our creativity.
examples.zh: 太多的规则可能会扼杀我们的创造力。

examples.en: A songwriter needs creativity and talent.
examples.zh: 一个歌曲创作者需要创造力和天赋。

examples.en: Your imagination shows your strong creativity.
examples.zh: 你的想象力显示出你很强的创造力。

examples.en: She certainly had a friend named Mark, but I don't know if he was her boyfriend.
examples.zh: 她肯定有一个叫马克的朋友，但我不知道他是不是她的男朋友。

examples.en: “This is a hard question.” “Yes, it's certainly not easy.”
examples.zh: “这是个难题。”“是的，当然不容易。”

examples.en: “Should we give more money to education?” “Certainly!”
examples.zh: “我们应该给教育更多钱吗？”“当然！”

examples.en: Please give me the car keys. You cannot drive now.
examples.zh: 请把车钥匙给我。你现在不能开车。

examples.en: I can't find my door key. It is lost.
examples.zh: 我找不到我的门钥匙了。它丢了。

examples.en: I heard someone turn a key in the door.
examples.zh: 我听到有人转动门锁里的钥匙。

examples.en: Many people make a living by teaching in this city.
examples.zh: 许多人在这个城市靠教书谋生。

examples.en: He makes a living by selling fresh vegetables.
examples.zh: 他靠卖新鲜蔬菜谋生。

examples.en: She made a living as a singer in her twenties.
examples.zh: 她二十多岁时以唱歌为生。

examples.en: She became a world-famous actress.
examples.zh: 她成为了一位举世闻名的女演员。

examples.en: He stayed in a world-famous hotel.
examples.zh: 他住在一家举世闻名的酒店里。

examples.en: That artist is world-famous now.
examples.zh: 那位艺术家现在举世闻名。

examples.en: The transport of live animals is not easy.
examples.zh: 活体动物的运输不容易。

examples.en: The company will help with your transport from the airport.
examples.zh: 公司会帮你安排从机场来的交通。

examples.en: The Department of Transport makes rules for buses and trains.
examples.zh: 交通部为公共汽车和火车制定规则。

examples.en: Have you watched any good movies recently?
examples.zh: 你最近看过什么好电影吗？

examples.en: He worked as a teacher until recently, but he still feels bad about it.
examples.zh: 他直到最近还在当老师，但他对此仍然感到难受。

examples.en: Recently, I have felt a little sad.
examples.zh: 最近，我感觉有点难过。

examples.en: I asked him to the show, but he'd already seen it.
examples.zh: 我请他去看展览，但他已经看过了。

examples.en: We got there late, and the concert had already started.
examples.zh: 我们到晚了，音乐会已经开始了。

examples.en: I've already told him about the plan.
examples.zh: 我已经把计划告诉他了。

examples.en: I haven't talked to her yet.
examples.zh: 我还没和她说话。

examples.en: He hasn't finished his homework yet.
examples.zh: 他还没完成作业。

examples.en: Are you ready? Not yet, wait a minute.
examples.zh: 你准备好了吗？还没，等一下。

examples.en: She lied to the doorman and said she was a reporter.
examples.zh: 她对门卫撒谎说她是记者。

examples.en: Our reporter in Washington gives us the latest news.
examples.zh: 我们在华盛顿的记者给我们带来最新消息。

examples.en: Many reporters waited outside the prime minister's house.
examples.zh: 许多记者在首相家外面等候。

examples.en: She fell in love with the little cat at first sight.
examples.zh: 她第一眼就爱上了这只小猫。

examples.en: Many students fall in love with reading after they join the book club.
examples.zh: 许多学生加入读书俱乐部后就爱上了阅读。

examples.en: He has fallen in love with the city because of its beautiful parks.
examples.zh: 因为美丽的公园，他已经爱上了这座城市。

examples.en: Use a ruler to draw a straight line.
examples.zh: 用尺子画一条直线。

examples.en: Please write your name on the dotted line.
examples.zh: 请在虚线上写下你的名字。

examples.en: The old woman had many lines on her face.
examples.zh: 那位老妇人脸上有很多皱纹。

examples.en: She stepped back and fell over a chair.
examples.zh: 她向后迈了一步，被椅子绊倒了。

examples.en: They stepped out onto the balcony.
examples.zh: 他们走到阳台上。

examples.en: Be careful not to step in the mud.
examples.zh: 小心别踩到泥里。

examples.en: There is a wide river near my school.
examples.zh: 我们学校附近有一条宽阔的河。

examples.en: Her eyes were wide with surprise when she saw the gift.
examples.zh: 她看到礼物时，惊讶得睁大了眼睛。

examples.en: The river is deep and wide, so we can't swim across it.
examples.zh: 这条河又深又宽，所以我们游不过去。

examples.en: I see a row of houses near the park.
examples.zh: 我看见公园附近有一排房子。

examples.en: We filled three rows of seats in the hall.
examples.zh: 我们坐满了大厅里的三排座位。

examples.en: The students stand in a row in front of the class.
examples.zh: 学生们在教室前面站成一排。

examples.en: Don't take your muddy shoes into the room.
examples.zh: 别把你的泥鞋带进房间。

examples.en: The muddy water made the river dirty.
examples.zh: 泥泞的水让河流变脏了。

examples.en: The wall was painted in muddy green and brown.
examples.zh: 这面墙被漆成了泥绿色和棕色。

examples.en: The old villager grows vegetables in his small garden.
examples.zh: 这位老村民在他的小菜园里种蔬菜。

examples.en: A kind villager showed us the way to the river.
examples.zh: 一位好心的村民给我们指了去河边的路。

examples.en: Every villager works hard on the farm before sunrise.
examples.zh: 每个村民都在日出前在农场上辛勤劳作。

examples.en: Is this a recent photo of your family?
examples.zh: 这是你们家最近的照片吗？

examples.en: Did you watch the recent sports news?
examples.zh: 你看了最近的体育新闻吗？

examples.en: In recent years, there is more violence on TV.
examples.zh: 近几年，电视上的暴力内容更多了。

examples.en: She felt hopeful about her exam result.
examples.zh: 她对考试结果抱有希望。

examples.en: We are hopeful of winning the game.
examples.zh: 我们满怀希望赢得比赛。

examples.en: I'm hopeful we can find a good solution.
examples.zh: 我希望能找到一个好办法。

examples.en: Over 150 guests came to the wedding party.
examples.zh: 超过150位宾客来参加了婚礼派对。

examples.en: We have two guests staying with us this weekend.
examples.zh: 这个周末有两位客人住在我们这里。

examples.en: Is his name on the guest list?
examples.zh: 他的名字在宾客名单上吗？

examples.en: We stayed in a small guest house by the sea.
examples.zh: 我们住在海边的一家小旅馆里。

examples.en: The guest house has only ten rooms, but it is clean.
examples.zh: 这家小旅馆只有十个房间，但是很干净。

examples.en: My parents booked a guest house for our trip.
examples.zh: 我父母为我们的旅行预订了一家小旅馆。

examples.en: Tourism is the most important business in Venice.
examples.zh: 旅游业是威尼斯最重要的行业。

examples.en: These old towns are still not much changed by tourism.
examples.zh: 这些老城镇还没有被旅游业改变太多。

examples.en: We must make tourism grow well with nature.
examples.zh: 我们必须让旅游业与自然和谐发展。

examples.en: Loss is a main theme in most of his novels.
examples.zh: 失去是他多数小说中的主要主题。

examples.en: Freedom is a theme that appears in her writing again and again.
examples.zh: 自由是她写作中反复出现的主题。

examples.en: The father-daughter bond is a common theme in her novels.
examples.zh: 父女关系是她小说中常见的主题。

examples.en: We had a great time at the theme park last Sunday.
examples.zh: 我们上周日在主题乐园玩得很开心。

examples.en: The theme park has many exciting rides for kids.
examples.zh: 这个主题乐园有很多刺激的游乐设施给孩子们玩。

examples.en: My parents took me to a big theme park on my birthday.
examples.zh: 我父母在我生日那天带我去了一个大型主题乐园。

examples.en: What's your opinion about this problem?
examples.zh: 你对这个问题的看法是什么？

examples.en: I want your opinion on the new timetable.
examples.zh: 我想听听你对新时间表的看法。

examples.en: They have different opinions on the movie.
examples.zh: 他们对这部电影有不同的看法。

examples.en: It is common to see couples wearing the same clothes.
examples.zh: 看到情侣穿一样的衣服很常见。

examples.en: Smith is a common name in Britain.
examples.zh: 史密斯在英国是一个常见的名字。

examples.en: Working at home is now very common.
examples.zh: 在家工作现在很普遍。

examples.en: According to Sarah, they don't get on well now.
examples.zh: 根据萨拉的说法，他们现在相处得不好。

examples.en: According to our records, you owe us 130 dollars.
examples.zh: 根据我们的记录，你欠我们130美元。

examples.en: According to reports, the ceasefire is still holding.
examples.zh: 根据报道，停火仍然有效。

examples.en: I like painting with watercolours best.
examples.zh: 我最喜欢用水彩画画。

examples.en: He has many beautiful watercolour paintings.
examples.zh: 他有许多漂亮的水彩画。

examples.en: She is learning to paint watercolours this term.
examples.zh: 这学期她正在学画水彩画。

examples.en: Do you prefer hot or cold weather?
examples.zh: 你更喜欢热天气还是冷天气？

examples.en: I prefer red to white.
examples.zh: 比起白色的，我更喜欢红色的。

examples.en: He prefers watching football to playing it.
examples.zh: 比起踢足球，他更喜欢看足球。

examples.en: I prefer apples to bananas for breakfast.
examples.zh: 早餐时，比起香蕉我更喜欢苹果。

examples.en: She prefers reading books to watching TV.
examples.zh: 比起看电视，她更喜欢读书。

examples.en: They prefer playing basketball to swimming.
examples.zh: 比起游泳，他们更喜欢打篮球。

examples.en: I learned to ride a bike at six.
examples.zh: 我六岁时学会了骑自行车。

examples.en: I ride my moped to work every day.
examples.zh: 我每天骑轻便摩托车去上班。

examples.en: I ride to work on my moped.
examples.zh: 我骑轻便摩托车去上班。

examples.en: Sudden loud noises scare her a lot.
examples.zh: 突然的巨响让她很害怕。

examples.en: She is very brave and doesn't scare easily.
examples.zh: 她很勇敢，不容易被吓到。

examples.en: He drove so fast that he scared me badly.
examples.zh: 他车开得太快，把我吓坏了。

examples.en: Walking is the best way to explore the countryside.
examples.zh: 步行是探索乡村最好的方式。

examples.en: Robots explore space now, not astronauts.
examples.zh: 现在探索太空的是机器人，不是宇航员。

examples.en: The kids went exploring in the woods.
examples.zh: 孩子们去树林里探险了。

examples.en: The doctor said he needed a few days' rest.
examples.zh: 医生说他需要休息几天。

examples.en: He stopped looking at the screen to rest his eyes.
examples.zh: 他不再看屏幕，让眼睛休息一下。

examples.en: She wouldn't rest until the killer was caught.
examples.zh: 在凶手被抓到之前，她不会停止寻找。

examples.en: The problem rests in his bad habits.
examples.zh: 问题在于他的坏习惯。

examples.en: Her happiness rests in helping others.
examples.zh: 她的快乐在于帮助别人。

examples.en: The key rests in practicing every day.
examples.zh: 关键就在于每天练习。

examples.en: We won't reach Miami until 5 or 6 o'clock.
examples.zh: 我们直到五六点钟才能到达迈阿密。

examples.en: They reached the coast after five weeks of sailing.
examples.zh: 他们航行了五周后终于到达了海岸。

examples.en: The news of his accident only reached us just now.
examples.zh: 他出事的消息我们刚刚才得知。

examples.en: He is the third richest man in this country.
examples.zh: 他是这个国家第三富有的人。

examples.en: They are one of the richest countries in the world.
examples.zh: 他们是世界上最富有的国家之一。

examples.en: He wants to get rich fast and works hard every day.
examples.zh: 他想快速致富，每天都很努力工作。

examples.en: Life in Los Angeles has many attractions, like clubs and nice restaurants.
examples.zh: 洛杉矶的生活有很多吸引人的地方，比如夜总会和好餐馆。

examples.en: The Great Wall is a famous tourist attraction in China.
examples.zh: 长城是中国著名的旅游景点。

examples.en: Traveling is one of the main attractions of this job.
examples.zh: 旅行是这份工作的主要吸引力之一。

examples.en: The panda is the best-protected animal in our zoo.
examples.zh: 熊猫是我们动物园里保护最好的动物。

examples.en: This old tree is the best-protected one in the park.
examples.zh: 这棵老树是公园里保护得最好的一棵。

examples.en: The baby turtles are the best-protected because people watch them.
examples.zh: 小海龟们被保护得最好，因为有人照看它们。

examples.en: If the product doesn't work, you can choose a refund or a new one.
examples.zh: 如果产品坏了，你可以选择退款或换一个新的。

examples.en: Making a choice is hard.
examples.zh: 做出一个选择很难。

examples.en: The choice is yours.
examples.zh: 选择权在你手里。

examples.en: In a historic vote, the church let women become priests.
examples.zh: 在一次历史性的投票中，教会允许女性成为牧师。

examples.en: The charity looks after 350 historic monuments.
examples.zh: 这家慈善机构照看着350处历史遗迹。

examples.en: This is a historic day for our country.
examples.zh: 对我们国家来说，这是具有历史意义的一天。

examples.en: This way makes learning fun.
examples.zh: 这种方法让学习变得有趣。

examples.en: These online learning places are called virtual schools.
examples.zh: 这些在线学习的地方叫做虚拟学校。

examples.en: For me, it was a great learning time.
examples.zh: 对我来说，那是一段很棒的学习时光。

examples.en: Which university did you go to?
examples.zh: 你上的是哪所大学？

examples.en: I was at a university in Beijing.
examples.zh: 我以前在北京的一所大学上学。

examples.en: Many students find university life fun and useful.
examples.zh: 很多学生觉得大学生活有趣又有用。

examples.en: Eating well and doing exercise can keep your body healthy.
examples.zh: 吃得好和多锻炼能让你的身体保持健康。

examples.en: She put suncream on her whole body.
examples.zh: 她把防晒霜涂满了全身。

examples.en: His body was fat, but his arms and legs were thin.
examples.zh: 他的身体很胖，但胳膊和腿很瘦。

examples.en: He often played the vibes in the studio with his band.
examples.zh: 他经常和乐队在录音室里演奏 vibes。

examples.en: She plays the vibes and sings on this album.
examples.zh: 她在这张专辑里演奏 vibes 并唱歌。

examples.en: Lionel plays the vibes, and others play piano, bass, and drums.
examples.zh: 莱昂内尔演奏 vibes，其他人演奏钢琴、贝斯和鼓。

examples.en: I need to go to the bank during my lunch break.
examples.zh: 我需要在午休时间去银行。

examples.en: Big banks often treat small companies unfairly.
examples.zh: 大银行常常不公平地对待小公司。

examples.en: I got a bank loan to start my shop.
examples.zh: 我贷款开了一家自己的店。

examples.en: Stratford-on-Avon is famous as Shakespeare's birthplace.
examples.zh: 埃文河畔斯特拉特福因是莎士比亚的出生地而闻名。

examples.en: I visited Haiti, the birthplace of my husband and me.
examples.zh: 我参观了海地，那是我丈夫和我的出生地。

examples.en: New Orleans is known as the birthplace of jazz.
examples.zh: 新奥尔良被誉为爵士乐的发源地。

examples.en: Beijing is the seat of power in China.
examples.zh: 北京是中国的中央政府所在地。

examples.en: The leader moved the seat of power to a new city.
examples.zh: 领导人把权力中心迁到了新城市。

examples.en: Many important decisions are made at the seat of power.
examples.zh: 许多重要决定都是在权力中心做出的。

examples.en: This wall part was built in the Ming dynasty to stop enemy attacks.
examples.zh: 这段墙是在明朝修建的，用来阻止敌人进攻。

examples.en: The Mogul dynasty ruled India for many years.
examples.zh: 莫卧儿王朝统治印度很多年。

examples.en: Elizabeth was the last queen of the Tudor dynasty.
examples.zh: 伊丽莎白是都铎王朝的最后一位女王。

examples.en: The new movie is a must-see for us.
examples.zh: 那部新电影是我们必看的。

examples.en: This museum is a must-see in Beijing.
examples.zh: 这个博物馆是北京必看的地方。

examples.en: The Great Wall is a must-see on your trip.
examples.zh: 长城是你旅行中必看的地方。

examples.en: The cave walls have very old paintings on them.
examples.zh: 山洞的墙壁上有非常古老的画。

examples.en: His scream echoed in the cave for a few seconds.
examples.zh: 他的尖叫声在山洞里回荡了几秒钟。

examples.en: She got hurt in a strange accident in a French cave.
examples.zh: 她在法国一个山洞里的一次奇怪事故中受伤了。

examples.en: These wooden carvings are very beautiful.
examples.zh: 这些木雕非常漂亮。

examples.en: He is good at carving stones.
examples.zh: 他擅长雕刻石头。

examples.en: I saw a small stone carving in the park.
examples.zh: 我在公园里看到一个小石雕。

examples.en: They were friends first, then became lovers.
examples.zh: 他们先做朋友，后来成了恋人。

examples.en: She had many lovers before her marriage ended.
examples.zh: 她婚姻结束前有过很多恋人。

examples.en: He is an opera lover and goes often.
examples.zh: 他是个歌剧爱好者，经常去听。

examples.en: The peony in our garden is red and beautiful.
examples.zh: 我们花园里的牡丹是红色的，很漂亮。

examples.en: My grandma plants many peonies in spring.
examples.zh: 我奶奶在春天种了许多牡丹。

examples.en: This peony smells sweet and looks lovely.
examples.zh: 这朵牡丹闻起来很香，看起来也很可爱。

examples.en: We often go abroad in summer.
examples.zh: 我们夏天经常出国。

examples.en: He is abroad for work now.
examples.zh: 他现在在国外工作。

examples.en: She moved abroad after her divorce.
examples.zh: 她离婚后移居国外了。

examples.en: Many Chinese students like to study at home and abroad.
examples.zh: 许多中国学生喜欢在国内和国外学习。

examples.en: The film is popular with people at home and abroad.
examples.zh: 这部电影在国内外的人们中很受欢迎。

examples.en: We can learn about culture at home and abroad through the Internet.
examples.zh: 我们可以通过互联网了解国内外文化。

examples.en: We stopped to admire the beautiful view.
examples.zh: 我们停下来欣赏美丽的景色。

examples.en: I really admire your jacket, Delia.
examples.zh: 黛莉娅，我真的很欣赏你的夹克。

examples.en: I admired him because he never gave up.
examples.zh: 我钦佩他，因为他从不放弃。

examples.en: She made her way to school early today.
examples.zh: 她今天早早地前往学校。

examples.en: We made our way to the park after lunch.
examples.zh: 午饭后我们前往公园。

examples.en: He is making his way to the library now.
examples.zh: 他现在正在前往图书馆。

examples.en: The ending of the movie has a dreamlike feel.
examples.zh: 电影的结尾有一种梦幻般的感觉。

examples.en: The car crash looked dreamlike and very slow.
examples.zh: 车祸看起来像梦境一样，而且非常慢。

examples.en: Her voice sounded dreamlike in the quiet room.
examples.zh: 她的声音在安静的房间里听起来像梦一样。

examples.en: My house is in central London.
examples.zh: 我的房子在伦敦市中心。

examples.en: A shop with a central location is more expensive to rent.
examples.zh: 位置在市中心（中心位置）的商店租金更贵。

examples.en: A bomb went off in central London this morning.
examples.zh: 今天早上伦敦市中心发生了一起炸弹爆炸。

examples.en: Soldiers walked around the streets at night.
examples.zh: 士兵们夜里在街上走来走去。

examples.en: The photo showed a soldier in his full uniform.
examples.zh: 照片里展示了一个穿着全套军装的士兵。

examples.en: Then a soldier shot at the car suddenly.
examples.zh: 然后一名士兵突然向汽车开枪。

examples.en: The building site is very busy today.
examples.zh: 建筑工地今天很繁忙。

examples.en: The site manager checks the work every day.
examples.zh: 工地经理每天检查工作。

examples.en: The company hasn't chosen the site for the new hospital yet.
examples.zh: 公司还没选好新医院的地点。

examples.en: Our company does business with many foreign friends.
examples.zh: 我们公司和许多外国朋友做生意。

examples.en: They found a good helper to do business with.
examples.zh: 他们找到了一个好帮手来一起做生意。

examples.en: Fewer shops are in business in this town now.
examples.zh: 现在这个镇上的商店在营业的更少了。

examples.en: Oil and water don't mix, even when you shake them.
examples.zh: 油和水不相溶，即使你摇晃它们也一样。

examples.en: Some dirty things were mixed into the water.
examples.zh: 一些脏东西被混合进了水里。

examples.en: Mix the eggs into the flour, please.
examples.zh: 请把鸡蛋混进面粉里。

examples.en: I stayed up until 3 a.m. to finish it.
examples.zh: 我熬夜到凌晨三点才完成它。

examples.en: Should we wait until Antony comes?
examples.zh: 我们应该等到安东尼来吗？

examples.en: We didn't eat until after midnight.
examples.zh: 我们直到午夜过后才吃饭。

examples.en: I did not go to bed until I finished my homework.
examples.zh: 我直到写完作业才去睡觉。

examples.en: She will not leave until her mother comes back.
examples.zh: 她直到妈妈回来才会离开。

examples.en: We did not start the game until the teacher arrived.
examples.zh: 我们直到老师来了才开始游戏。

examples.en: Please leave a message if I am not at home.
examples.zh: 如果我不在家，请留言。

examples.en: Don't give your bank card number to a message you don't know.
examples.zh: 不要把银行卡号给陌生的信息。

examples.en: I got a message that she will come late.
examples.zh: 我收到一条消息，说她会晚到。

examples.en: You can't find a better plumber anywhere in England.
examples.zh: 你在英格兰任何地方都找不到更好的水管工了。

examples.en: Go anywhere in the world, and you will see hamburger shops.
examples.zh: 去世界上任何地方，你都会看到汉堡店。

examples.en: I wondered if there was anywhere to fix this.
examples.zh: 我想知道有没有什么地方能修这个。

examples.en: Men usually marry later than women.
examples.zh: 男性通常比女性结婚晚。

examples.en: Paul married Lucy four years ago.
examples.zh: 保罗四年前和露西结婚了。

examples.en: They have no plans to marry now.
examples.zh: 他们现在没有结婚的计划。

examples.en: All the artwork in this book is from the author.
examples.zh: 这本书里的所有艺术品都出自作者之手。

examples.en: The student made a nice artwork for the class project.
examples.zh: 这个学生为班级项目制作了一件漂亮的艺术品。

examples.en: We saw many great artworks at the museum last weekend.
examples.zh: 上周末我们在博物馆看到了许多很棒的艺术品。

examples.en: Does she learn classical ballet or modern ballet?
examples.zh: 她学的是古典芭蕾还是现代芭蕾？

examples.en: I usually listen to pop music, not classical music.
examples.zh: 我通常听流行音乐，不听古典音乐。

examples.en: He is one of the best classical actors we have.
examples.zh: 他是我们最好的古典演员之一。

examples.en: The dog struggled to get free from the wire.
examples.zh: 狗挣扎着要从铁丝中挣脱出来。

examples.en: I struggled to understand this article all afternoon.
examples.zh: 我整个下午都在努力理解这篇文章。

examples.en: Fish struggle for survival when the lake water drops.
examples.zh: 湖水下降时，鱼为生存而努力挣扎。

examples.en: She works far from home for long periods.
examples.zh: 她长期在离家很远的地方工作。

examples.en: Unemployment was lower this year than in the same period last year.
examples.zh: 今年失业率比去年同期低。

examples.en: Fifteen people died over a period of four days.
examples.zh: 十五个人在四天的时间里死去了。

examples.en: He is a war hero from his country.
examples.zh: 他是来自他国家的战争英雄。

examples.en: She was a national hero in Australia.
examples.zh: 她在澳大利亚是一位民族英雄。

examples.en: He became an accidental hero by stopping a robbery.
examples.zh: 他无意中阻止了一起抢劫，成了意外英雄。

examples.en: I have asked him twice already.
examples.zh: 我已经问过他两次了。

examples.en: The mail comes twice a day.
examples.zh: 邮件每天来两次。

examples.en: There are twice as many houses here as before.
examples.zh: 这里的房子比以前多两倍。

examples.en: She likes to show off her new dress to her friends.
examples.zh: 她喜欢向朋友们炫耀她的新裙子。

examples.en: The white walls show off the colorful paintings well.
examples.zh: 白色的墙壁很好地衬托出这些色彩斑斓的画作。

examples.en: He always shows off his good grades in class.
examples.zh: 他总是在班上炫耀他的好成绩。

examples.en: No matter what happens, stay calm.
examples.zh: 无论发生什么，都要保持冷静。

examples.en: No matter how hard it is, I will try.
examples.zh: 不管有多难，我都会尝试。

examples.en: Please call me no matter when you arrive.
examples.zh: 无论你什么时候到达，请给我打电话。

examples.en: If you want to open a file, click the icon twice.
examples.zh: 如果你想打开文件，就双击图标。

examples.en: After you pick a file, click the 'Open' button.
examples.zh: 选好文件后，点击“打开”按钮。

examples.en: Draw a shape, click on it, and copy it.
examples.zh: 画一个形状，点击它，然后复制。

examples.en: Rimini is a busy town on the east coast of Italy.
examples.zh: 里米尼是意大利东海岸一个热闹的城镇。

examples.en: The accident happened three miles off the coast.
examples.zh: 事故发生在离海岸三英里的海上。

examples.en: We spent a week by the coast last summer.
examples.zh: 去年夏天我们在海边度过了一周。

examples.en: Meat must be cooked well before we eat it.
examples.zh: 肉在吃之前必须煮熟。

examples.en: I must get some sleep now.
examples.zh: 我现在必须睡一会儿。

examples.en: You mustn't show this letter to others.
examples.zh: 你不可以把这封信给其他人看。

examples.en: Do you want to listen to jazz, classical, or pop?
examples.zh: 你想听爵士乐、古典乐还是流行乐？

examples.en: They play old folk songs and new pop music.
examples.zh: 他们演奏古老的民歌和新的流行音乐。

examples.en: They write great pop songs you can enjoy again and again.
examples.zh: 他们写很棒的流行歌曲，你可以一遍遍地欣赏。

examples.en: The band had some horn players.
examples.zh: 这支乐队有一些吹号角的乐手。

examples.en: The Beatles were maybe the most famous band ever.
examples.zh: 披头士可能是史上最有名的乐队。

examples.en: My brother plays drums in a rock band.
examples.zh: 我哥哥在一个摇滚乐队里打鼓。

examples.en: Her English speaking is second to none in our class.
examples.zh: 她的英语口语在我们班无人能及。

examples.en: The new library's design is second to none in the city.
examples.zh: 新图书馆的设计在这个城市无人能及。

examples.en: My grandmother's cooking is second to none, I love it.
examples.zh: 我奶奶的厨艺无人能及，我很喜欢。

examples.en: He lived only a few days after the car hit him.
examples.zh: 车祸后他只活了几天。

examples.en: I hope I live to see my grandchildren.
examples.zh: 我希望我能活到看见我的孙子孙女们。

examples.en: Her granny lived to be 94 years old.
examples.zh: 她奶奶活到了94岁。

examples.en: As for the test, I think it is easy.
examples.zh: 至于考试，我觉得它很容易。

examples.en: As for my sister, she likes music a lot.
examples.zh: 至于我妹妹，她非常喜欢音乐。

examples.en: As for the plan, we need more time.
examples.zh: 至于那个计划，我们需要更多时间。

examples.en: I ate a slice of bread for breakfast.
examples.zh: 我早餐吃了一片面包。

examples.en: She put some lemon slices in her tea.
examples.zh: 她在茶里放了几片柠檬。

examples.en: Would you like another slice of cake?
examples.zh: 你想再来一片蛋糕吗？

examples.en: The river looks truly beautiful at this time of year.
examples.zh: 每年这个时候，这条河看起来真的很美。

examples.en: She was truly a great actress.
examples.zh: 她确实是一位伟大的女演员。

examples.en: This success is truly amazing.
examples.zh: 这个成功真的很了不起。

examples.en: To reach the restaurant, cross the bridge.
examples.zh: 要到达餐厅，请走过那座桥。

examples.en: We drove over the bridge yesterday.
examples.zh: 我们昨天开车过了那座桥。

examples.en: The Brooklyn Bridge is very famous in New York.
examples.zh: 布鲁克林大桥在纽约非常有名。

examples.en: I have doubts about his ability to do the job.
examples.zh: 我对他做这份工作的能力有怀疑。

examples.en: If we have any doubt about the rocket's engines, we should cancel the launch.
examples.zh: 如果我们对火箭发动机有任何怀疑，就应该取消发射。

examples.en: The company's actions have cast doubt over its ability to save the business.
examples.zh: 公司的行为让人怀疑它能否挽救这家亏损的企业。

examples.en: No doubt, she is the best singer in our class.
examples.zh: 毫无疑问，她是我们班最好的歌手。

examples.en: He will win the game, no doubt about it.
examples.zh: 他会赢得比赛，这一点毫无疑问。

examples.en: No doubt you are tired after the long trip.
examples.zh: 毫无疑问，长途旅行后你累了。

examples.en: My lunch box has a bit of everything, like rice, eggs, and apples.
examples.zh: 我的午餐盒里什么都有一点，比如米饭、鸡蛋和苹果。

examples.en: He knows a bit of everything about sports, from soccer to swimming.
examples.zh: 他对运动什么都知道一点，从足球到游泳。

examples.en: The party had music, games, and food — a bit of everything.
examples.zh: 聚会上有音乐、游戏和食物——什么都有。

examples.en: The teacher counted the students on the bus.
examples.zh: 老师数了数公交车上的学生。

examples.en: Count your money to see if it's all there.
examples.zh: 数一数你的钱，看看是不是都在。

examples.en: Let's count out loud from one to ten.
examples.zh: 我们从一数到十，大声数出来。

examples.en: We count down the days before the summer holiday.
examples.zh: 我们倒数着暑假前的日子。

examples.en: The students count down the seconds before the New Year.

examples.zh: 这位年轻的图书管理员知道孩子们喜欢什么书。

examples.en: The library pays part-time clerks to save money, not trained librarians.
examples.zh: 图书馆雇兼职员工来省钱，而不是用受过训练的图书管理员。

examples.en: She is an astronomy librarian and works with other special librarians.
examples.zh: 她是一位天文图书管理员，和其他专业图书管理员一起工作。

examples.en: I want to check out this book from the library.
examples.zh: 我想从图书馆借出这本书。

examples.en: She checked out two DVDs yesterday.
examples.zh: 她昨天借了两张DVD。

examples.en: You can check out five books at a time.
examples.zh: 你一次可以借五本书。

examples.en: My uncle works in a famous publishing house.
examples.zh: 我叔叔在一家著名的出版社工作。

examples.en: The publishing house sent the new books to the school.
examples.zh: 出版社把新书送到了学校。

examples.en: She wants to visit the publishing house with her class.
examples.zh: 她想和班级一起参观这家出版社。

examples.en: He is an unwilling helper in the kitchen.
examples.zh: 他在厨房里是个不情愿的帮手。

examples.en: She was unwilling to give the money to him.
examples.zh: 她不愿意把钱给他。

examples.en: I was unwilling to use all the money at once.
examples.zh: 我不愿意一下子花光所有的钱。

examples.en: The company gets money from each house sale.
examples.zh: 公司从每笔房屋销售中赚钱。

examples.en: The sale of alcohol is not allowed.
examples.zh: 酒类销售是不允许的。

examples.en: I haven't made a sale all morning.
examples.zh: 我一上午都没卖出一件东西。

examples.en: They copied the design from the Japanese model and made it better.
examples.zh: 他们从日本型号上复制了设计，并把它做得更好。

examples.en: The old painting has been copied many times.
examples.zh: 这幅古画已经被复制了很多次。

examples.en: They practiced handwriting by copying.
examples.zh: 他们通过抄写来练习书法。

examples.en: Many people eat less meat, especially young people.
examples.zh: 很多人少吃肉，尤其是年轻人。

examples.en: Sleep is especially important for children.
examples.zh: 睡眠对儿童尤其重要。

examples.en: This app is especially useful for people working at home.
examples.zh: 这个应用对在家工作的人尤其有用。

examples.en: We study both classical and modern literature in class.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂上学习古典文学和现代文学。

examples.en: Wuthering Heights is a famous English literature classic.
examples.zh: 《呼啸山庄》是一部著名的英国文学经典。

examples.en: He knows a lot about German literature and shares it with us.
examples.zh: 他对德国文学很了解，并和我们分享。

examples.en: His funny and smart writing makes his column a must-read.
examples.zh: 他风趣又聪明的写作使他的专栏成为必读。

examples.en: This book is a must-read for Cold War fans.
examples.zh: 这本书是冷战爱好者的必读之作。

examples.en: This article is a must-read for students.
examples.zh: 这篇文章是学生的必读文章。

examples.en: Janet edited books for different publishers.
examples.zh: 珍妮特为不同的出版商编辑书籍。

examples.en: He sent his 400-page book to the publisher.
examples.zh: 他把400页的书稿寄给了出版商。

examples.en: It was hard to find a publisher for her first novel.
examples.zh: 为她的第一部小说找出版商很难。

examples.en: Some software pirates steal others' work.
examples.zh: 一些软件盗版者窃取别人的成果。

examples.en: They used the trailer as a pirate radio station.
examples.zh: 他们用这辆拖车作为盗版电台。

examples.en: Much of this software is pirated online.
examples.zh: 这个软件很多都是网上盗版的。

examples.en: He is a great reader and always has a book in his hand.
examples.zh: 他是一个很爱读书的人，手里总拿着一本书。

examples.en: She is an avid reader of historical novels.
examples.zh: 她是历史小说的狂热读者。

examples.en: We asked our readers to write to us and share their ideas.
examples.zh: 我们请读者写信给我们，分享他们的想法。

examples.en: We finished the job, but it was with great difficulty.
examples.zh: 我们完成了工作，但非常困难。

examples.en: The difficulty of the task made them excited.
examples.zh: 任务的困难让他们兴奋。

examples.en: She had great difficulty finding a job.
examples.zh: 她找工作很困难。

examples.en: I have difficulty in finishing my homework on time.
examples.zh: 我按时完成作业有困难。

examples.en: She had difficulty understanding the math problem.
examples.zh: 她理解这道数学题有困难。

examples.en: They will have difficulty finding the right way home.
examples.zh: 他们找到正确的回家路会有困难。

examples.en: Who owns the copyright on this article?
examples.zh: 谁拥有这篇文章的版权？

examples.en: The photographer holds the copyright on all the wedding photos.
examples.zh: 那位摄影师拥有所有婚礼照片的版权。

examples.en: His work is no longer protected by copyright.
examples.zh: 他的作品不再受版权保护。

examples.en: Are we all in agreement with the plan?
examples.zh: 我们都同意这个计划吗？

examples.en: Her family was in agreement with her decision.
examples.zh: 她的家人同意她的决定。

examples.en: The two sides finally reached an agreement.
examples.zh: 双方最终达成了协议。

examples.en: Are you sure people will buy this product in the market?
examples.zh: 你确定市场上会有人买这个产品吗？

examples.en: We think about one million people in this country may want the new phones in the market.
examples.zh: 我们估计这个国家大约有一百万人可能想要市场上的新手机。

examples.en: The home market is weak, but foreign demand is getting better.
examples.zh: 国内市场不景气，但国外需求正在好转。

examples.en: Please excuse me for being late. The bus was late.
examples.zh: 请原谅我迟到了。公共汽车晚点了。

examples.en: Nothing can excuse that kind of behavior.
examples.zh: 没有任何理由可以原谅那种行为。

examples.en: No money can excuse how the company did its plan.
examples.zh: 多少钱都不能原谅公司执行计划的方式。

examples.en: Excuse me, can you tell me the way to the library?
examples.zh: 劳驾，你能告诉我去图书馆的路吗？

examples.en: Excuse me, I didn't mean to step on your foot.
examples.zh: 请原谅，我不是故意踩你的脚的。

examples.en: Excuse me, could I borrow your pen for a minute?
examples.zh: 劳驾，我能借你的钢笔用一下吗？

examples.en: Please take one book at a time.
examples.zh: 请每次只拿一本书。

examples.en: He ate two apples at a time.
examples.zh: 他一次吃了两个苹果。

examples.en: We should do one thing at a time.
examples.zh: 我们应该每次只做一件事。

examples.en: Most Californians live within 15 miles of the sea.
examples.zh: 大多数加州人住在离海15英里以内的地方。

examples.en: In 1992, the EU ended border checks within its countries.
examples.zh: 1992年，欧盟取消了其国家内部的边境检查。

examples.en: For UK orders, please add £2.50 for post within the country.
examples.zh: 英国国内的订单，请加2.50英镑邮费。

examples.en: Can you describe the man who hurt you?
examples.zh: 你能描述一下那个伤害你的人吗？

examples.en: He described the painting very carefully.
examples.zh: 他非常仔细地描述了那幅画。

examples.en: Describe to us how you felt when you won.
examples.zh: 跟我们描述一下你赢的时候的感觉。

examples.en: She reads a medical journal every week.
examples.zh: 她每周都读一本医学杂志。

examples.en: He worked for the famous Irish journal The Bell.
examples.zh: 他为著名的爱尔兰杂志《钟》工作过。

examples.en: He copied a full part from a journal.
examples.zh: 他从一本杂志上抄了一整段。

examples.en: The title of his first book was 'Decline and Fall'.
examples.zh: 他第一本书的标题是《衰落与倒塌》。

examples.en: This song is the title track of the album 'The Red Shoes'.
examples.zh: 这首歌是专辑《红鞋》的同名主打歌。

examples.en: The bridge appears in the opening titles of the movie.
examples.zh: 那座桥出现在电影的开场片名中。

examples.en: Don't throw food on the floor. That's naughty!
examples.zh: 别把食物扔地上。那太淘气了！

examples.en: Our boss often treats us like naughty kids.
examples.zh: 我们老板常把我们当淘气的孩子对待。

examples.en: You borrowed my car without asking. That was naughty.
examples.zh: 你没问就借了我的车。那太淘气了。

examples.en: They visited many faraway places last summer.
examples.zh: 他们去年夏天去了许多遥远的地方。

examples.en: Few people remember the war in that faraway land.
examples.zh: 很少有人记得那个遥远国度的战争。

examples.en: She had a faraway look when she thought of home.
examples.zh: 她想起家时，眼神显得很遥远。

examples.en: They live on a large island in Japan.
examples.zh: 他们住在日本的一个大岛上。

examples.en: The island is in the Pacific Ocean.
examples.zh: 这个岛在太平洋上。

examples.en: No one lives on that desert island.
examples.zh: 那个荒岛上没有人住。

examples.en: She hasn't called, even though she said she would.
examples.zh: 尽管她说会打电话，但她还没打。

examples.en: They're coming next week, though I don't know the day.
examples.zh: 他们下周来，尽管我不知道是哪天。

examples.en: You look though you ran a long race.
examples.zh: 你看起来好像跑了一场长跑。

examples.en: He needs to learn some manners at home.
examples.zh: 他需要在家里学一些礼仪。

examples.en: Eating with your mouth open is bad manners.
examples.zh: 张着嘴吃东西是不礼貌的。

examples.en: In some places, leaving food on your plate shows good manners.
examples.zh: 在一些地方，盘子里剩点食物是礼貌的表现。

examples.en: Two percent of fast-food boxes become litter.
examples.zh: 百分之二的快餐盒变成了垃圾。

examples.en: The cat gave birth to a litter of kittens.
examples.zh: 这只猫生了一窝小猫。

examples.en: We need to buy some cat litter for our pet.
examples.zh: 我们需要给宠物买一些猫砂。

examples.en: I heard him tap his fingers on the desk.
examples.zh: 我听到他用手指敲桌子。

examples.en: The branches tapped against the window.
examples.zh: 树枝敲打着窗户。

examples.en: I was tapping my feet to the music.
examples.zh: 我随着音乐轻轻跺着脚。

examples.en: We should wait in line when buying tickets.
examples.zh: 买票时我们应该排队等候。

examples.en: The students waited in line for the school bus.
examples.zh: 学生们排队等候校车。

examples.en: Please wait in line at the supermarket, don't push.
examples.zh: 在超市请排队等候，不要推挤。

examples.en: People waited patiently in line for the bus.
examples.zh: 人们排队耐心地等公交车。

examples.en: She listened to my story patiently.
examples.zh: 她耐心地听我讲故事。

examples.en: He patiently tried to tell her the facts.
examples.zh: 他耐心地试着告诉她事实。

examples.en: You won the game. Congratulations!
examples.zh: 你赢了比赛。恭喜！

examples.en: She gave him a card with congratulations.
examples.zh: 她给了他一张祝贺卡。

examples.en: He passed the exam. Congratulations to him!
examples.zh: 他通过了考试。祝贺他！

examples.en: Our classroom is at the end of the hallway.
examples.zh: 我们的教室在走廊的尽头。

examples.en: Please don't run in the hallway between classes.
examples.zh: 课间请不要在走廊里跑。

examples.en: I saw my friend waiting in the hallway this morning.
examples.zh: 今天早上我看见我的朋友在走廊里等候。

examples.en: Please arrive at school on time tomorrow morning.
examples.zh: 明天早上请准时到校。

examples.en: The train left the station on time yesterday.
examples.zh: 火车昨天准时离开了车站。

examples.en: She finished her homework on time and watched TV.
examples.zh: 她准时完成了作业，然后看了电视。

examples.en: I feel at home in my new school because the teachers are kind.
examples.zh: 我在新学校感到自在，因为老师都很和蔼。

examples.en: After a week, the exchange student felt at home with his host family.
examples.zh: 一周后，那名交换生和寄宿家庭在一起就感到不拘束了。

examples.en: The cozy sofa makes every guest feel at home.
examples.zh: 这张舒适的沙发让每位客人都感到舒服自在。

examples.en: Are the phones working normally again?
examples.zh: 这些电话又正常工作了吗？

examples.en: She doesn't normally arrive until ten.
examples.zh: 她通常十点才到。

examples.en: Normally, I plan one or two days ahead.
examples.zh: 通常，我会提前一两天做计划。

examples.en: Please write your home address here.
examples.zh: 请在这里写下你的家庭住址。

examples.en: I need to tell you about my change of address.
examples.zh: 我需要告诉你我换地址了。

examples.en: The police looked at an address for the drug case.
examples.zh: 警察为了毒品案子查看了一个地址。

examples.en: They asked how he was only out of politeness.
examples.zh: 他们问他怎么样只是出于礼貌。

examples.en: She smiled because of the boy's politeness.
examples.zh: 她因为男孩的礼貌而笑了。

examples.en: She wants to bring politeness back to schools.
examples.zh: 她想把礼貌带回学校。

examples.en: She didn't realize the danger.
examples.zh: 她没有意识到危险。

examples.en: Do you realize you forgot it again?
examples.zh: 你意识到你又忘了吗？

examples.en: I realize it's hard, but we must try.
examples.zh: 我意识到这很难，但我们必须试试。

examples.en: They didn't realize they were in danger.
examples.zh: 他们没有意识到自己身处危险之中。

examples.en: She said angrily, "Do you realize this is your third time forgetting?"
examples.zh: 她生气地说：“你意识到这是你第三次忘记了吗？”

examples.en: I realize how hard it will be, but we must try.
examples.zh: 我意识到这会有多难，但我们必须试一试。

examples.en: She always behaves badly when her aunts visit.
examples.zh: 她姑妈们来时，她总表现得很差。

examples.en: She always behaves well when her aunts visit.
examples.zh: 她姑妈们来时，她总表现得好。

examples.en: He behaved strangely on full moon nights.
examples.zh: 满月的夜晚他表现得很奇怪。

examples.en: Are girls treated differently at school?
examples.zh: 女孩在学校里被区别对待吗？

examples.en: He didn't behave differently with her.
examples.zh: 他对待她时并没有表现得不一一样。

examples.en: People act differently when on TV.
examples.zh: 人们上电视时会表现得很不一样。

examples.en: He should be praised for telling the truth.
examples.zh: 他应该因为说了真话而受到称赞。

examples.en: My parents always praised me when I got good grades.
examples.zh: 我父母总是在我取得好成绩时表扬我。

examples.en: He was highly praised for his study on heart disease.
examples.zh: 他因对心脏病的研究而受到高度赞扬。

examples.en: She had a pleased smile on her face.
examples.zh: 她脸上带着高兴的微笑。

examples.en: Are you pleased about his new job?
examples.zh: 你对他找到新工作感到高兴吗？

examples.en: We're pleased that you can come to the party.
examples.zh: 你能来参加聚会，我们很高兴。

examples.en: I asked, "Where are you going?" He replied, "Home."
examples.zh: 我问：“你去哪儿？”他回答：“回家。”

examples.en: I replied that it was twelve o'clock.
examples.zh: 我回答说当时是十二点。

examples.en: I try to reply to letters on the same day.
examples.zh: 我尽量当天回复信件。

examples.en: They are rich, but they live in a modest house.
examples.zh: 他们虽然有钱，但住在一栋朴素的房子里。

examples.en: The poor now have a modest improvement in housing.
examples.zh: 穷人的住房条件现在有了一点改善。

examples.en: The party made a modest gain in the election, not a huge one.
examples.zh: 那个政党在选举中只获得了小幅增长，而不是很大的增长。

examples.en: They openly looked down on my ideas.
examples.zh: 他们公开地看不起我的想法。

examples.en: We talked about our worries about the deal openly.
examples.zh: 我们公开地谈论了对这笔交易的担忧。

examples.en: I'm tired of secret meetings—let's talk openly.
examples.zh: 我厌倦了秘密会议——让我们公开谈吧。

examples.en: We thanked our hosts for the happy evening.
examples.zh: 我们感谢主人让我们度过了愉快的夜晚。

examples.en: The school is looking for host families for foreign students.
examples.zh: 这所学校正在为外国学生寻找寄宿家庭。

examples.en: Our host wore a clown costume at the party.
examples.zh: 我们的主人在聚会上穿着小丑服装。

examples.en: The villagers were hospitable to all visitors.
examples.zh: 村民们对所有来访者都很热情好客。

examples.en: The moon is not a hospitable place for people.
examples.zh: 月球对人们来说不是一个宜居的地方。

examples.en: Our host was very hospitable and friendly.
examples.zh: 我们的主人非常热情好客，也很友好。

examples.en: We use paper plates for the picnic.
examples.zh: 我们野餐时用纸盘子。

examples.en: She put the salad on a big plate.
examples.zh: 她把沙拉放在一个大盘子里。

examples.en: Please wash the dirty plates after dinner.
examples.zh: 晚饭后请把脏盘子洗了。

examples.en: He asked me for money again, but I refused.
examples.zh: 他又向我要钱，但我拒绝了。

examples.en: He is in trouble, but he refused all my help.
examples.zh: 他遇到麻烦了，但他拒绝了我所有的帮助。

examples.en: On cold mornings, the car often refuses to start.
examples.zh: 在寒冷的早晨，汽车常常启动不了。

examples.en: She is used to getting up early on school days.
examples.zh: 她习惯了上学日早起。

examples.en: We are used to the cold weather in winter.
examples.zh: 我们习惯了冬天寒冷的天气。

examples.en: He gets used to taking the bus to school quickly.
examples.zh: 他很快就习惯了坐公交上学。

examples.en: Have you fully recovered from your cold?
examples.zh: 你感冒完全好了吗？

examples.en: I fully planned to call you last night.
examples.zh: 我昨晚原本完全打算给你打电话的。

examples.en: Sorry, the hotel is fully booked tonight.
examples.zh: 抱歉，今晚酒店已经全部订满了。

examples.en: All at once, the students stood up and said hello.
examples.zh: 学生们同时站起来问好。

examples.en: Don't speak all at once; raise your hands first.
examples.zh: 不要一起说话，先举手。

examples.en: The lights went out all at once during the storm.
examples.zh: 暴风雨中，灯一下子全灭了。

examples.en: Don't jump the line; wait for your turn.
examples.zh: 不要插队，等轮到你。

examples.en: He jumped the line and everyone was angry.
examples.zh: 他插队了，大家都很生气。

examples.en: It is rude to jump the line in a queue.
examples.zh: 在队伍中插队是不礼貌的。

examples.en: She spoke loudly in the class.
examples.zh: 她在课堂上大声说话。

examples.en: Don't talk loudly in the library.
examples.zh: 不要在图书馆里大声说话。

examples.en: The boy laughed loudly at the joke.
examples.zh: 那个男孩听到笑话后大声笑了。

examples.en: You push the table and I will pull it.
examples.zh: 你推桌子，我来拉它。

examples.en: The window is stuck, so push it hard.
examples.zh: 窗户卡住了，所以用力推它。

examples.en: He pushed my car off the road to help me.
examples.zh: 他把我的车推离了道路来帮我。

examples.en: I live on Station Road, just past the post office.
examples.zh: 我住在车站路，刚过邮局。

examples.en: Three boys went past us on bikes.
examples.zh: 三个男孩骑自行车经过了我们的身边。

examples.en: Peter jogged past us in pink shorts.
examples.zh: 彼得穿着粉色短裤慢跑经过了我们的身边。

examples.en: We will have discussions with our classmates about the trip.
examples.zh: 我们将和同学讨论这次旅行。

examples.en: The plan is still under discussion now.
examples.zh: 这个计划现在还在讨论中。

examples.en: Please join our discussion group after class.
examples.zh: 课后请加入我们的讨论小组。

examples.en: He promised to call me every week.
examples.zh: 他承诺每周给我打电话。

examples.en: The government promised to reduce taxes.
examples.zh: 政府承诺减税。

examples.en: Promise me you won't tell him.
examples.zh: 答应我你不告诉他。

examples.en: You should always keep your word to your friends.
examples.zh: 你应该总是对朋友信守诺言。

examples.en: He kept his word and helped me with my math.
examples.zh: 他信守诺言，帮我学了数学。

examples.en: She is a good girl and always keeps her word.
examples.zh: 她是个好女孩，总是信守诺言。

examples.en: The pear tree we planted never had any fruit.
examples.zh: 我们种的梨树从来没有结过果子。

examples.en: My mom made a pear flan for us.
examples.zh: 我妈妈给我们做了一个梨馅饼。

examples.en: Do you like pears cooked in red wine?
examples.zh: 你喜欢红酒煮梨吗？

examples.en: Even though it rained, we still played football.
examples.zh: 尽管下雨了，我们还是踢了足球。

examples.en: She passed the exam even though she was sick.

examples.zh: 我们的短期目标是解决资金问题，但长期目标是让公司变得更好。

examples.en: The leaflet is made with the aim of helping people know more about this disease.
examples.zh: 这份传单的制作目的是帮助人们更多地了解这种疾病。

examples.en: I am Dr. Stephens' patient. Can I make an appointment?
examples.zh: 我是斯蒂芬斯医生的病人。我能预约一下吗？

examples.en: Most patients can leave the hospital after 72 hours.
examples.zh: 大多数病人在72小时后可以出院。

examples.en: The doctor will treat the patient carefully.
examples.zh: 医生会仔细治疗这位病人。

examples.en: I don't know how he can afford a new car with his salary.
examples.zh: 我不知道他靠工资怎么买得起新车。

examples.en: The small hut afforded us little protection from the rain.
examples.zh: 这个小茅屋几乎不能为我们遮雨。

examples.en: Her seat afforded her a clear view of the stage.
examples.zh: 她的座位让她能清楚地看到舞台。

examples.en: I have a fever, so I must go to hospital tomorrow.
examples.zh: 我发烧了，所以明天必须去医院看病。

examples.en: She went to hospital because her leg hurt badly.
examples.zh: 她因为腿疼得厉害去了医院看病。

examples.en: If you feel sick, you should go to hospital quickly.
examples.zh: 如果你感觉不舒服，你应该尽快去医院看病。

examples.en: All passengers must be on board before the ship leaves.
examples.zh: 船开之前，所有乘客必须上船。

examples.en: We felt safe on board the plane during the storm.
examples.zh: 暴风雨期间，我们在飞机上感到安全。

examples.en: There are many fun activities on board the train.
examples.zh: 火车上有许多有趣的活动。

examples.en: The oil discovery brought many benefits to the town.
examples.zh: 石油的发现给这个镇子带来了很多好处。

examples.en: Traveling abroad benefits you by teaching you to deal with surprises.
examples.zh: 出国旅行让你学会应对意外，这让你受益。

examples.en: He benefited from a great education, but he still works as a waiter.
examples.zh: 他受益于良好的教育，但他仍然做服务员。

examples.en: We should do eye care every day to protect our eyes.
examples.zh: 我们应该每天做眼睛保健来保护我们的眼睛。

examples.en: The teacher told us eye care is important for students.
examples.zh: 老师告诉我们眼睛保健对学生很重要。

examples.en: After long screen time, eye care helps relax your eyes.
examples.zh: 长时间看屏幕后，眼睛保健有助于放松你的眼睛。

examples.en: The parliamentary session will end on May 27.
examples.zh: 议会会议将于5月27日结束。

examples.en: The UN Security Council held an emergency session to talk about the crisis.
examples.zh: 联合国安理会召开紧急会议来讨论这场危机。

examples.en: The UN had an emergency session to talk about the problem.
examples.zh: 联合国举行了一次紧急会议来讨论这个问题。

examples.en: Can you operate this remote control?
examples.zh: 你会操作这个遥控器吗？

examples.en: Does the company operate a savings plan?
examples.zh: 这家公司运作一个储蓄计划吗？

examples.en: She operated a matchmaking service at home.
examples.zh: 她在家运作一个婚介服务。

examples.en: The doctors will operate on my uncle tomorrow morning.
examples.zh: 医生们明天早上给我叔叔做手术。

examples.en: A famous surgeon operated on his broken leg last week.
examples.zh: 一位著名的外科医生上周给他断裂的腿做了手术。

examples.en: They are operating on the patient with heart problem now.
examples.zh: 他们现在正在给那位有心脏问题的病人做手术。

examples.en: My parents treated us all the same when we were kids.
examples.zh: 小时候，我父母对我们一视同仁。

examples.en: He treated his wife very badly.
examples.zh: 他对他妻子很不好。

examples.en: It's wrong to treat animals as if they had no feelings.
examples.zh: 把动物当作没有感情的东西是不对的。

examples.en: Please carry on with your homework after dinner.
examples.zh: 晚饭后请继续做你的作业。

examples.en: She carried on with her reading in the library.
examples.zh: 她在图书馆里继续看书。

examples.en: We will carry on with the game when it stops raining.
examples.zh: 雨停后我们将继续比赛。

examples.en: I have a job interview tomorrow morning.
examples.zh: 我明天早上有一场工作面试。

examples.en: They will have interviews for the new teacher next week.
examples.zh: 他们下周将为新老师进行面试。

examples.en: She had an interview with a famous writer yesterday.
examples.zh: 她昨天采访了一位著名作家。

examples.en: We are very grateful to all who helped us.
examples.zh: 我们非常感谢所有帮助我们的人。

examples.en: I would be grateful for your help.
examples.zh: 我会很感激你的帮助。

examples.en: If you finish the report by Thursday, I'll be grateful.
examples.zh: 如果你周四前完成报告，我会很感激。

examples.en: The city center fell into darkness after the power cut.
examples.zh: 停电后，市中心陷入了黑暗。

examples.en: They walked up the beach in darkness.
examples.zh: 他们在黑暗中沿着海滩走着。

examples.en: I could see almost nothing in the darkness.
examples.zh: 在黑暗中我几乎什么都看不见。

examples.en: The kids have a math test twice a week, and it includes addition and subtraction.
examples.zh: 孩子们每周有两次数学测试，内容包括加法和减法。

examples.en: Besides his New York apartment, he owns a house in Italy and a castle in Scotland.
examples.zh: 除了他在纽约的公寓，他还在意大利有一栋房子，在苏格兰有一座城堡。

examples.en: He says tofu is a useful addition to other meat substitutes.
examples.zh: 他说豆腐是对其他肉类替代品的有用补充。

examples.en: In addition to apples, she bought some bananas.
examples.zh: 除了苹果以外，她还买了一些香蕉。

examples.en: He studies hard. In addition, he helps others.
examples.zh: 他学习努力。此外，他还帮助别人。

examples.en: In addition to English, we learn math and science.
examples.zh: 除了英语以外，我们还学数学和科学。

examples.en: Our hotel room was directly above a noisy street.
examples.zh: 我们的酒店房间就在一条吵闹的街道正上方。

examples.en: The disease is directly related to bad water pipes.
examples.zh: 这种疾病与坏的水管直接相关。

examples.en: The sun shone directly into my eyes.
examples.zh: 阳光直接照进我的眼睛里。

examples.en: A freight train went off the track yesterday, so the line was closed.
examples.zh: 昨天一列货运火车脱轨了，所以这条线路被封了。

examples.en: The train to Beijing is late because of a signal problem.
examples.zh: 开往北京的火车因为信号问题晚点了。

examples.en: We planned to have a fun train journey together.
examples.zh: 我们计划一起进行一次有趣的火车旅行。

examples.en: The demonstrators gave leaflets to people on the street.
examples.zh: 示威者把传单发给了街上的人。

examples.en: Today we got a leaflet about the new bus services at home.
examples.zh: 今天我们在家收到了一张关于新公交服务的传单。

examples.en: Putting leaflets in churches, barbers, and community centers helps win votes.
examples.zh: 在教堂、理发店和社区中心放传单有助于赢得选票。

examples.en: The teacher will hand out the test papers tomorrow.
examples.zh: 老师明天会分发试卷。

examples.en: Please hand out these books to your classmates.
examples.zh: 请把这些书分发给你的同学们。

examples.en: They handed out free water at the sports meeting.
examples.zh: 他们在运动会上分发了免费的水。

examples.en: He is an Olympic champion swimmer.
examples.zh: 他是一名奥运冠军游泳运动员。

examples.en: She won the world champion title three years in a row.
examples.zh: 她连续三年获得世界冠军称号。

examples.en: The champion will play his first game tomorrow.
examples.zh: 这位冠军明天将打他的第一场比赛。

examples.en: You got three answers right and two wrong.
examples.zh: 你答对了三道题，错了两道。

examples.en: I set the clock to the right time.
examples.zh: 我把钟调到了正确的时间。

examples.en: "Is that Ms Kramer?" "Yes, that's right."
examples.zh: “那是克莱默女士吗？”“是的，没错。”

examples.en: Technology is progressing fast in recent years.
examples.zh: 近年来科技发展很快。

examples.en: I am not making much progress in learning Spanish.
examples.zh: 我学西班牙语进步不大。

examples.en: The doctor said she was making good progress after the illness.
examples.zh: 医生说她在病后恢复得很好。

examples.en: The chickenpox virus can make kids feel sick.
examples.zh: 水痘病毒会让孩子生病。

examples.en: The AIDS virus spread quickly among people.
examples.zh: 艾滋病病毒在人群中传播得很快。

examples.en: I don't know what's wrong with her. Maybe she has a virus.
examples.zh: 我不知道她怎么了，也许她感染了病毒。

examples.en: Don't sleep late or you'll miss out on the morning exercise.
examples.zh: 别睡懒觉，否则你会错过晨练的机会。

examples.en: She missed out on the school trip because she was sick.
examples.zh: 她因为生病错过了学校旅行。

examples.en: If you don't join the club, you may miss out on making new friends.
examples.zh: 如果你不加入这个俱乐部，你可能会错失结交新朋友的机会。

examples.en: We must stop the nuclear war to save the world.
examples.zh: 我们必须阻止核战争来拯救世界。

examples.en: He watched a war film about a brave hero.
examples.zh: 他看了一部关于勇敢英雄的战争电影。

examples.en: If the country goes to war, many people will die.
examples.zh: 如果这个国家卷入战争，很多人会死去。

examples.en: She wanted to work for a bigger and more influential newspaper.
examples.zh: 她想为一家更大、更有影响力的报纸工作。

examples.en: Johnson was influential in getting money for the film.
examples.zh: 约翰逊在为电影筹钱方面很有影响力。

examples.en: He knows how to make friends with influential people.
examples.zh: 他知道如何与有影响力的人交朋友。

examples.en: This is light and fertile soil for planting.
examples.zh: 这是适合种植的轻质肥沃土壤。

examples.en: Sandy soils are easy for plants to grow in.
examples.zh: 沙质土壤容易让植物生长。

examples.en: It was the first time we walked on American soil.
examples.zh: 那是我们第一次踏上美国的土地。

examples.en: The government will use fewer chemicals in food.
examples.zh: 政府将在食品中使用更少的化学品。

examples.en: Factories put toxic chemicals into the air every year.
examples.zh: 工厂每年把有毒化学品排放到空气中。

examples.en: They use chemicals to help crops grow faster.
examples.zh: 他们用化学品帮助庄稼长得更快。

examples.en: An overturned truck blocked the whole road.
examples.zh: 一辆翻倒的卡车堵住了整条路。

examples.en: He got a job driving a truck.
examples.zh: 他找到了一份开卡车的工作。

examples.en: She can drive a big truck easily.
examples.zh: 她能轻松地开大卡车。

examples.en: Drinking unclean water can make you sick.
examples.zh: 喝不干净的水会让你生病。

examples.en: This shirt is unclean, so put on a clean one.
examples.zh: 这件衬衫不干净，换一件干净的吧。

examples.en: Your hands are unclean, so wash them before dinner.
examples.zh: 你的手不干净，吃饭前要洗手。

examples.en: Wood, coal, oil, and gas are all common fuels.
examples.zh: 木头、煤、石油和天然气都是常见的燃料。

examples.en: Plutonium is a fuel that makes nuclear energy.
examples.zh: 钚是一种产生核能的燃料。

examples.en: The old nuclear fuel is kept at the plant now.
examples.zh: 废核燃料现在存放在核电站里。

examples.en: I poured the juice, but I spilled some.
examples.zh: 我倒果汁时，洒了一些。

examples.en: Pour the honey into the bowl and mix it well.
examples.zh: 把蜂蜜倒进碗里，好好搅拌。

examples.en: Can I pour you some more water?
examples.zh: 我能再给你倒点水吗？

examples.en: I want my car to have air conditioning.
examples.zh: 我希望我的车有空调。

examples.en: The coach has air conditioning and comfortable seats.
examples.zh: 这辆长途车有空调和舒适的座位。

examples.en: How can you work in this heat without air conditioning?
examples.zh: 这么热没有空调你怎么工作？

examples.en: The building is eco-friendly and saves heating money.
examples.zh: 这座建筑很环保，还能节省取暖费用。

examples.en: These eco-friendly shops help recycle your old things.
examples.zh: 这些环保商店帮助你回收旧东西。

examples.en: This detergent is eco-friendly and safe.
examples.zh: 这种洗涤剂既环保又安全。

examples.en: The art and music departments are in two separate buildings.
examples.zh: 美术系和音乐系在两栋分开的大楼里。

examples.en: In the fridge, I keep meat separate from other food.
examples.zh: 在冰箱里，我把肉和其他食物分开放。

examples.en: I keep my public life and private life separate.
examples.zh: 我把我的公共生活和私人生活分开。

examples.en: We separate the class into four groups.
examples.zh: 我们把班级分成四个小组。

examples.en: She separated the apples into two baskets.
examples.zh: 她把苹果分成两个篮子。

examples.en: Please separate the rubbish into different bins.
examples.zh: 请把垃圾分成不同的垃圾桶。

examples.en: The Japanese recycle over half of their waste paper.
examples.zh: 日本人回收利用了他们一半以上的废纸。

examples.en: Should I throw away this bottle, or can you recycle it?
examples.zh: 我应该扔掉这个瓶子，还是你可以回收它？

examples.en: Why not recycle old Christmas cards as gift tags?
examples.zh: 为什么不把旧圣诞卡回收做成礼物标签呢？

examples.en: The lake's water level is higher after heavy rain.
examples.zh: 大雨后，湖里的水位更高了。

examples.en: Prices will go up two percent from the current level.
examples.zh: 价格将从目前的水平上涨百分之二。

examples.en: Playing chess at a high level needs much focus.
examples.zh: 高水平下棋需要非常专注。

examples.en: Many patients were successfully treated with the new drug.
examples.zh: 许多病人用这种新药得到了成功的治疗。

examples.en: The book successfully shows the horror of war.
examples.zh: 这本书成功地展现了战争的恐怖。

examples.en: He successfully balances family life and his job.
examples.zh: 他成功地平衡了家庭生活和工作。

examples.en: At that time, cars with one person were about 80% of the total.
examples.zh: 在那个时间，只有一个人的汽车约占总数的80%。

examples.en: A total of 21 horses joined the race.
examples.zh: 总共有21匹马参加了比赛。

examples.en: We made $1,000 in total in three days.
examples.zh: 我们三天总共赚了1000美元。

examples.en: My parents were strict with me when I was young.
examples.zh: 我小时候父母对我很严格。

examples.en: Stricter rules on air pollution can help reduce acid rain.
examples.zh: 更严格的空气污染规定有助于减少酸雨。

examples.en: The city has a strict curfew from night to morning.
examples.zh: 这座城市从晚上到早上有严格的宵禁。

examples.en: If you can't control your dog, keep it on a rope.
examples.zh: 如果你管不住你的狗，就把它拴在绳子上。

examples.en: You must learn to control your anger.
examples.zh: 你必须学会控制自己的脾气。

examples.en: A machine controls the room temperature.
examples.zh: 一台机器控制着室内温度。

examples.en: I dropped the vase and it broke into pieces.
examples.zh: 我把花瓶掉在地上，它碎成了碎片。

examples.en: I picked it up and the handle broke off.
examples.zh: 我把它捡起来，把手断了。

examples.en: The dish fell to the floor and broke.
examples.zh: 盘子掉到地上碎了。

examples.en: People who break the law must go to court and be punished.
examples.zh: 违法的人必须上法庭并受到惩罚。

examples.en: The teacher punished the class with more homework.
examples.zh: 老师用更多作业惩罚全班。

examples.en: The oil company got a big fine and was punished for polluting.
examples.zh: 那家石油公司因污染被罚了一大笔钱并受到惩罚。

examples.en: The police fined him for parking here.
examples.zh: 警察因他在这里停车而罚款。

examples.en: She was fined for running the red light.
examples.zh: 她因闯红灯被罚款了。

examples.en: They fined the driver for speeding on the road.
examples.zh: 他们因司机在路上超速而罚款。

examples.en: A country's best resource is its hardworking people.
examples.zh: 一个国家最好的资源是勤劳的人民。

examples.en: Britain's mineral resources include coal and gas.
examples.zh: 英国的矿产资源包括煤炭和天然气。

examples.en: This book is a useful resource for students.
examples.zh: 这本书对学生来说是有用的资源。

examples.en: Sienna wisely left the party before the trouble.
examples.zh: 西耶娜明智地在麻烦发生前离开了聚会。

examples.en: Use your money wisely.
examples.zh: 明智地使用你的钱。

examples.en: He wisely chose a safe job.
examples.zh: 他明智地选择了一份安全的工作。

examples.en: We ran out of milk, so I went to buy some.
examples.zh: 我们的牛奶喝完了，所以我去买了一些。

examples.en: My phone battery always runs out quickly.
examples.zh: 我的手机电池总是很快就用完了。

examples.en: They will run out of time if they don't hurry.
examples.zh: 如果他们不快点，时间就会用完了。

examples.en: Volunteering at school can make a difference in our community.
examples.zh: 在学校做志愿者能对我们的社区产生影响。

examples.en: Your small help may make a big difference to others.
examples.zh: 你的小小帮助可能会对他人产生很大的作用。

examples.en: Everyone can make a difference by protecting the environment.
examples.zh: 每个人都能通过保护环境发挥作用。

examples.en: The company lost money because of bad management.
examples.zh: 这家公司因为管理不善而亏损了。

examples.en: We need stricter management of our money.
examples.zh: 我们需要更严格地管理我们的钱。

examples.en: The management training program starts next week.
examples.zh: 管理培训项目下周开始。

examples.en: The students put up posters on the wall.
examples.zh: 学生们把海报贴在了墙上。

examples.en: We saw a poster showing a circus show.
examples.zh: 我们看到了一张展示马戏表演的海报。

examples.en: That poster is very bright and easy to see.
examples.zh: 那张海报非常鲜艳，容易看到。

examples.en: Farm chemicals are polluting clean water.
examples.zh: 农场化学品正在污染干净的水。

examples.en: We won't buy from companies that pollute nature.
examples.zh: 我们不会从污染自然的公司买东西。

examples.en: Some TV shows pollute people's minds with bad content.
examples.zh: 一些电视节目用不良内容污染人们的思想。

examples.en: The fire badly affected both buildings.
examples.zh: 大火严重影响了两栋楼。

examples.en: Her parents' divorce affected all parts of her life.
examples.zh: 她父母的离婚影响了她生活的方方面面。

examples.en: This disease mainly affects old people.
examples.zh: 这种病主要影响老年人。

examples.en: Oxygen, hydrogen, and nitrogen are all common gases.
examples.zh: 氧气、氢气和氮气都是常见的气体。

examples.en: The air in the room was full of poisonous gas.
examples.zh: 房间里的空气充满了有毒气体。

examples.en: We use gas to cook, but my mom likes electricity better.
examples.zh: 我们用天然气做饭，但我妈妈更喜欢用电。

examples.en: A seabird flew over the blue ocean.
examples.zh: 一只海鸟飞过蓝色的大海。

examples.en: Seabirds often eat fish near the coast.
examples.zh: 海鸟经常在海岸附近吃鱼。

examples.en: The seabird dived into the water for food.
examples.zh: 那只海鸟潜入水中寻找食物。

examples.en: Trees can stop desertification and give us shade and firewood.
examples.zh: 树木能阻止沙漠化，并给我们提供树荫和柴火。

examples.en: Desertification makes farms and villages become dry and empty.
examples.zh: 沙漠化使农场和村庄变得干燥和空旷。

examples.en: Planting more trees is a good way to fight desertification.
examples.zh: 种更多的树是抵抗沙漠化的好方法。

examples.en: I could hardly hear her in the back.
examples.zh: 我在后面几乎听不见她说话。

examples.en: The party had hardly started when she left.
examples.zh: 聚会几乎刚开始她就离开了。

examples.en: He hardly ate anything at lunch.
examples.zh: 他午饭几乎什么都没吃。

examples.en: People now know that single-use bags hurt the environment.
examples.zh: 人们现在知道一次性袋子会伤害环境。

examples.en: The single-use medicine bottles were used again on other patients.
examples.zh: 一次性药瓶被再次用在了其他病人身上。

examples.en: Many single-use boxes go into recycling bins.
examples.zh: 很多一次性盒子被扔进回收箱。

examples.en: This bike is second-hand but still works well.
examples.zh: 这辆自行车是二手的，但还能用得很好。

examples.en: She buys all her clothes second-hand.
examples.zh: 她所有的衣服都买二手的。

examples.en: He sells second-hand cars at his shop.
examples.zh: 他在他的店里卖二手车。

examples.en: I need a rechargeable battery for my camera.
examples.zh: 我需要一块可充电电池给我的相机。

examples.en: This toy car needs two medium-sized batteries.
examples.zh: 这个玩具车需要两节中号电池。

examples.en: My phone's battery is dying, so I must charge it soon.
examples.zh: 我的手机电池快没电了，所以我得赶紧充电。

examples.en: I play music on an electronic keyboard.
examples.zh: 我在电子琴上弹奏音乐。

examples.en: We use many electronic devices at home.
examples.zh: 我们在家使用很多电子设备。

examples.en: The electronic sound is very loud.
examples.zh: 电子声音非常响亮。

examples.en: We turned off the electricity yesterday.
examples.zh: 昨天我们关了电。

examples.en: The company makes electricity for the city.
examples.zh: 这家公司为城市发电。

examples.en: The machine works by electricity.
examples.zh: 这台机器靠电运转。
